package.name: whill_localization
package.description: Odom-layer localization bringup for the WHILL chair. Provides the M4-R odom-layer EKF (`robot_localization`) that fuses wheel odometry and IMU into the `odom -> base_link` TF and `/odometry/filtered` topic — the surface Nav2 and the M6-R scan-to-map localizer consume. (The FAST-LIO runtime-localizer launches and config this package once carried were removed 2026-07-22; runtime localization is now `lidar_localization_ros2` and map-making is GLIM — see the package README.)
